verifications.claim: Jack Nicklaus holds the record for the most Masters tournament wins.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Nicklaus, who also holds the record for most Masters victories with six" (R1); "Jack Nicklaus - 6" (R2); "Jack Nicklaus is the lone six-time winner" (R3); "Jack Nicklaus has won the Masters more than any other golfer... six green jackets" (R4); "Nicklaus holds the record for the most Masters Championship wins with six" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state Nicklaus has the most wins with six.

verifications.claim: Jack Nicklaus has six Masters tournament wins in 1963, 1965, 1966, 1972, 1975, 1986.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources list exactly six wins with the precise years matching the claim.

verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm Woods has five, second to Nicklaus's six.
